definitions.explanation: Working together with shared goals and shared effort. The {協|きょう} emphasizes coordination toward a common purpose, often institutional, as in {協同|きょうどう}{組合|くみあい} (cooperative).

examples.japanese: {地域|ちいき}の{農業|のうぎょう}{協同|きょうどう}{組合|くみあい}に{入|はい}った。
examples.english: I joined the local agricultural cooperative.

examples.japanese: {二|ふた}つの{会社|かいしゃ}が{協同|きょうどう}して{新製品|しんせいひん}を{開発|かいはつ}した。
examples.english: Two companies cooperated to develop a new product.

examples.japanese: {住民|じゅうみん}と{行政|ぎょうせい}の{協同|きょうどう}によって{町|まち}おこしが{進|すす}められている。
examples.english: Town revitalization is being advanced through cooperation between residents and the local government.

notes:
Often confused with {共同|きょうどう} (same reading). {協同|きょうどう} stresses cooperating toward a shared goal with coordinated effort, while {共同|きょうどう} stresses simply doing or owning something together. {協同|きょうどう} is much more common in formal organizational names.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {協同|きょうどう}{組合|くみあい}: cooperative (organization)
- {農業|のうぎょう}{協同|きょうどう}{組合|くみあい} ({農協|のうきょう}): agricultural cooperative
- {生活|せいかつ}{協同|きょうどう}{組合|くみあい} ({生協|せいきょう}): consumer cooperative
- {協同|きょうどう}{作業|さぎょう}: joint/cooperative work
- {協同|きょうどう}する: to cooperate; to work together

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {共同|きょうどう}: joint; shared — focuses on sharing or doing together; more common overall
- {協力|きょうりょく}: cooperation — emphasizes giving help; broadest of the three
- {連携|れんけい}: coordination; collaboration — emphasizes linkage between parties
